newsitem.title: USA: Columbia Banking buys Cascade unit.
newsitem.headline: Columbia Banking buys Cascade unit.

text.p: Columbia Banking System Inc said Tuesday it has agreed to acquire Cascade Bancorp Inc unit Cascade Community Bank.
The unit will be merged into Columbia Bank.
The company said in a statement stockholders of Cascade Bancorp will receive 2.27 shares of Columbia Banking System common stock for each share of Cascade common stock.

Cascade Community Bank's President Don Lisko is expected to become a senior officer of Columbia Bank, and Cascade's Chairman Thomas Matson will be appointed to serve on Columbia's Boards of Directors.
The agreement has been approved by both boards of directors and is expected to close in the fourth quarter pending shareholder and regulatory approval.
